name: gkwa/thesourdoughjourney-method-check
summary: Evaluate whether Tom Cucuzza's two-factor bulk fermentation method (dough temperature plus percentage rise) applies to a sourdough recipe, and if not, which way the error swings (over- or under-fermentation) and what target to use instead. Trigger terms: tom's method, tom cucuzza, percentage rise, two-factor method, bulk fermentation method, does tom's method apply, over-ferment, under-ferment.
